sections.description: Prevents duplicate document title tags when Yoast SEO is used with a WordPress block theme.
sections.changelog:
= 1.3.1 =
* Use the plugin name without an MTT prefix; retain Made to Thrive authorship and the handwritten mtt icon.

= 1.3.0 =
* Adds the Made to Thrive versioned update channel.
* Keeps automatic updates disabled unless the agency explicitly opts in.
* Raises the minimum PHP version to 8.1 for the new maintained release line.

= 1.2.0 =
* Removes the core title before its hook priority begins.
* Restores the core title when Yoast does not produce a non-empty title.

= 1.1.0 =
* Only removes the WordPress title after confirming Yoast's title presenter ran.
* Preserves the WordPress title on block themes where Yoast does not output one.

= 1.0.0 =
* Initial release.
